name: Connector — 1x07
description: Connector — 1x07 (0.1in and 2.0mm pitch pin headers/sockets in through-hole and SMD mounts) from SparkFun-KiCad-Libraries, used for single-row 7-position board interconnects.
selection_hints: Match footprint pitch and mount exactly: 1x07_P2.54mm (THT), 1x07_P2.54mm_Locking, or 1x07_P2.0mm_Socket_Vertical (PTH or SMD).
Prefer the tier A entry (Conn_01x07_P2.54mm, score 88) when a standard 0.1in header is acceptable.
Use the locking variant only if the design requires a retention/locking connector body.
Confirm SMD vs through-hole mounting matches the intended assembly process.
avoid_when: The design needs a pin count other than 7.
The required pitch is not 2.54mm or 2.0mm.
Electrical current/voltage rating is needed but not stated by the selected part.
The symbol-footprint pairing is unverified or flagged for review.
